observable_requirements.contract: When an expandable Search component is rendered in its collapsed/unexpanded state (with `onExpand` and `isExpanded={false}`), the Tooltip wrapping the magnifier icon button must render with standard icon tooltip styling (`cds--icon-tooltip` / `${prefix}--icon-tooltip`), eliminating the default caret/arrow popover style and conforming to standard Carbon icon button tooltip appearance.

preserved_behaviors: When the Search component is not expandable (no `onExpand`), no tooltip wrapper is rendered on the magnifier.
When the expandable Search is expanded (`isExpanded={true}`), the magnifier button is rendered without the collapsed tooltip wrapper.
Keyboard and mouse interactions to expand the search via click, Enter, and Space remain unchanged.
behavioral_contract.implementation_variation: Any implementation that ensures the magnifier tooltip on unexpanded expandable search carries standard icon tooltip semantics and class (`prefix--icon-tooltip`) or standard IconButton tooltip styling without breaking tooltip label or alignment is valid.
